categories.main_business_segments: Taisei Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: Civil Engineering, Building Construction, and Real Estate Development. The group also engages in related businesses such as research, technical consulting, and environmental measurement, with a network of 61 consolidated subsidiaries and 67 equity-method affiliates. Civil Engineering covers infrastructure and public works, Building Construction focuses on commercial and residential buildings, and Development involves real estate sales, land development, and property leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Taisei leverages advanced construction technologies, digital transformation (DX), and sustainability-focused methods. Key innovations include automation and remote operation of construction machinery, AI-driven project management, digital twin and BIM/CIM integration, low-carbon and recycled materials (e.g., T-eConcrete®), and ZEB (Zero Energy Building) solutions. The company emphasizes productivity improvements, environmental impact reduction, and safety/quality management through proprietary systems and continuous R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base including government agencies, private corporations, real estate developers, and industrial clients. Its main markets are public infrastructure, commercial and residential buildings, and real estate development, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales. Taisei also targets overseas markets, particularly in Asia and emerging economies, for infrastructure and building projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Taisei's core operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets, but it also has a significant international presence, especially in Southeast Asia (Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia) and the United States. The company operates through domestic branches and subsidiaries as well as overseas subsidiaries and affiliates, focusing on both domestic and select overseas growth markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taisei operates primarily as a general contractor (downstream) in the construction supply chain, managing end-to-end project delivery from design and engineering to construction and maintenance. It also engages in upstream activities through real estate development and procurement, and collaborates with suppliers and subcontractors for materials and specialized services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategy centers on sustainable growth, digital transformation, and addressing social/environmental challenges. Under 'TAISEI VISION 2030,' priorities include carbon neutrality, circular economy, nature-positive initiatives, disaster resilience, and labor productivity. R&D focuses on automation, AI, green materials, ZEB, and new business models, with significant investment in environmental and energy-related technologies and human capital development.
categories.revenue_model: Taisei generates revenue primarily through construction contracts (civil engineering and building), real estate sales, property leasing, and related services. Revenue recognition is based on project progress (percentage-of-completion method) for construction, and upon delivery or lease commencement for real estate. The company also earns income from technical consulting, research, and facility management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taisei is one of Japan's 'Big Five' general contractors, competing with Shimizu, Kajima, Obayashi, and Takenaka. It holds a leading position in both civil engineering and building construction, with a strong reputation for technological innovation and large-scale project management. The company differentiates itself through its integrated development capabilities and focus on sustainability and digital transformation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, Taisei reported consolidated net sales of ¥2,154.2 billion and net income attributable to shareholders of ¥123.8 billion, with total assets of ¥2,428.8 billion and 16,382 employees. The company experienced strong growth in both sales (+22.1%) and profits (+207.5%) year-on-year, driven by large-scale project execution and improved margins. The medium-term plan targets further growth, aiming for ¥1,950 billion in sales and ¥80 billion in net profit by FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taisei emphasizes its ability to deliver safe, high-quality, and sustainable infrastructure and buildings, leveraging advanced technology, integrated development expertise, and a strong commitment to ESG and stakeholder value. Its unique strengths include proprietary green construction materials, digitalized project management, and a holistic approach to urban development and environmental stewardship, positioning the company as a leader in resilient, future-ready construction solutions.
